paper_title: SRPO Enhancing Multimodal LLM Reasoning via Reflection-Aware   Reinforcement Learning
caption_used: Accuracy comparison of six reinforcement learning configurations across three benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. Each benchmark displays grouped bars for DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (hatched blue), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (hatched orange), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (hatched green). In Mathverse, SRPO achieves the highest accuracy at approximately 56%, while DAPO+Self-reflection follows at roughly 55%, with the remaining methods clustered between 53% and 54%. Across MMLU, GRPO leads with approximately 57%, narrowly exceeding DAPO+Self-reflection, and PPO trails at about 54.5%. In the Physics benchmark, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches roughly 61%, with SRPO close behind at 60.5% and PPO at the lowest with approximately 57%. Notably, the self-reflection variants do not consistently outperform their base counterparts, as GRPO surpasses PPO+Self-reflection in both Mathverse and MMLU.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата илюстрира сравнение на точността (Accuracy) на шест конфигурации за обучение с подкрепление върху три бенчмарка: Mathverse, MMLU и Physics. Хоризонталната ос съдържа трите бенчмарка, подредени отляво надясно в реда Mathverse, MMLU и Physics, без видима азбучна или друга систематична подредба. Вертикалната ос е етикетирана като „Accuracy (%)" и обхваща диапазон от приблизително 50% до 62%, със скала, която изглежда линейна и маркирана на интервали от 2 процентни пункта (52, 54, 56, 58, 60, 62). За всеки бенчмарк са представени шест групирани стълба, съответстващи на шестте метода, обозначени в легендата в горната част на диаграмата: DAPO+Self-reflection (плътен син), DAPO (щрихован син), SRPO (плътен оранжев), GRPO (щрихован оранжев), PPO+Self-reflection (плътен зелен) и PPO (щрихован зелен). Стълбите в рамките на всяка група са подредени последователно в реда, в който методите са изброени в легендата. Визуалното разграничение между базовите методи и техните варианти със саморефлексия е постигнато чрез използване на плътно запълване за вариантите със саморефлексия и диагонално щриховане за базовите методи, като цветовата схема (син, оранжев, зелен) разграничава тройките DAPO, SRPO/GRPO и PPO. В групата Mathverse стълбите варират приблизително между 53% и 56%, като най-високият стълб е този на DAPO+Self-reflection с около 56%, а най-ниският — DAPO с приблизително 53%. В групата MMLU стойностите се разпростират приблизително от 54.5% до 57%, като DAPO+Self-reflection достига около 57%, а PPO показва най-ниска стойност от около 54.5%. В групата Physics стълбите обхващат по-широк диапазон — приблизително от 57% до 61%, като най-високият стълб е на DAPO+Self-reflection с около 61%, а най-ниският — на GRPO с приблизително 57%. Няма допълнителни визуални акценти като удебеляване, очертаване или анотации върху отделни стълби извън описаните цветови и щриховъчни разлики.
model_annotations.Chinese: 这张柱状图展示了六种强化学习配置在三个基准测试（Mathverse、MMLU和Physics）上的准确率比较。水平轴为类别轴，依次标注了Mathverse、MMLU和Physics三个基准测试名称；垂直轴为数值轴，标签为"Accuracy (%)"，范围从50%到62%，刻度间隔为2个百分点。每个基准测试下方排列了六根分组柱状图，分别代表六种方法：DAPO+Self-reflection（实心蓝色）、DAPO（带斜线填充的蓝色）、SRPO（实心橙色）、GRPO（带斜线填充的橙色）、PPO+Self-reflection（实心深绿色）和PPO（带斜线填充的浅绿色），图例位于图表上方区域。在Mathverse组中，DAPO+Self-reflection约为53.1%，DAPO约为56.1%，SRPO约为53.5%，GRPO约为53.3%，PPO+Self-reflection约为55.8%，PPO约为54.5%，其中DAPO的柱状图最高，DAPO+Self-reflection最低。在MMLU组中，DAPO+Self-reflection约为55.8%，DAPO约为57.0%，SRPO约为57.1%，GRPO约为56.0%，PPO+Self-reflection约为54.8%，PPO约为56.2%，其中SRPO略高于DAPO，PPO+Self-reflection最低。在Physics组中，DAPO+Self-reflection约为57.5%，DAPO约为58.1%，SRPO约为60.5%，GRPO约为61.0%，PPO+Self-reflection约为56.8%，PPO约为59.1%，其中GRPO达到最高值约61%，PPO+Self-reflection最低约56.8%。每组内六根柱状图从左到右的排列顺序一致，依次为DAPO+Self-reflection、DAPO、SRPO、GRPO、PPO+Self-reflection、PPO。实心填充与斜线填充的交替使用区分了带有Self-reflection的变体与其基础方法，以及不同算法族群之间的差异。柱状图未按数值大小排序，而是按固定的方法顺序排列，图中未见对特定柱状图的额外视觉强调或注释标记。
model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the accuracy comparison of six reinforcement learning configurations across three benchmarks: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis displays the three benchmark categories in the order Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics, while the vertical axis represents Accuracy (%) on a linear scale ranging from approximately 50% to 62%, with tick marks at 52%, 54%, 56%, 58%, 60%, and 62%. Within each benchmark group, six bars are displayed side by side corresponding to six methods identified in the legend: DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (hatched blue with diagonal lines), SRPO (solid orange), GRPO (hatched orange with diagonal lines), PPO+Self-reflection (solid dark green), and PPO (hatched green with diagonal lines). For the Mathverse benchmark, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches approximately 53%, DAPO approximately 56%, SRPO approximately 55.8%, GRPO approximately 53.5%, PPO+Self-reflection approximately 53.3%, and PPO approximately 54.5%. For the MMLU benchmark, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches approximately 55.8%, DAPO approximately 57%, SRPO approximately 57.2%, GRPO approximately 56%, PPO+Self-reflection approximately 54.8%, and PPO approximately 56.2%. For the Physics benchmark, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches approximately 57.5%, DAPO approximately 58.2%, SRPO approximately 60.5%, GRPO approximately 61%, PPO+Self-reflection approximately 56.8%, and PPO approximately 59.1%. The bars within each group are arranged in a consistent left-to-right order matching the legend sequence, and the visual distinction between solid and hatched fills differentiates the self-reflection variants from their base counterparts. The bars are not sorted by value but rather maintain a fixed method ordering across all three benchmarks, and no bars appear to be specially emphasized through bolding, outlining, or annotation beyond the hatching pattern used to distinguish base methods from their self-reflection-augmented versions.
model_annotations.German: Das Diagramm zeigt einen Genauigkeitsvergleich (Accuracy) von sechs verschiedenen Reinforcement-Learning-Konfigurationen über drei Benchmarks hinweg: Mathverse, MMLU und Physics. Die horizontale Achse (Kategorienachse) enthält diese drei Benchmark-Bezeichnungen, während die vertikale Achse mit „Accuracy (%)" beschriftet ist und einen Wertebereich von etwa 50 % bis 62 % abdeckt, mit regelmäßigen Tick-Markierungen bei 52 %, 54 %, 56 %, 58 %, 60 % und 62 %. Für jeden Benchmark sind sechs Balken gruppiert dargestellt, die gemäß der Legende folgende Methoden repräsentieren: DAPO+Self-reflection (einfarbig blau), DAPO (blau schraffiert), SRPO (einfarbig orange), GRPO (orange schraffiert), PPO+Self-reflection (einfarbig grün) und PPO (grün schraffiert). Die Balken sind innerhalb jeder Gruppe in dieser Reihenfolge von links nach rechts angeordnet. Im Benchmark Mathverse liegt DAPO+Self-reflection bei etwa 53 %, DAPO bei ungefähr 56 %, SRPO bei circa 53,5 %, GRPO bei etwa 55,8 %, PPO+Self-reflection bei rund 53,3 % und PPO bei ungefähr 54,5 %. Im Benchmark MMLU erreicht DAPO+Self-reflection etwa 55,8 %, DAPO ungefähr 57 %, SRPO circa 57,2 %, GRPO etwa 56 %, PPO+Self-reflection rund 54,8 % und PPO ungefähr 56,2 %. Im Physics-Benchmark zeigt DAPO+Self-reflection einen Wert von etwa 57,5 %, DAPO erreicht ungefähr 61 %, SRPO liegt bei circa 58,2 %, GRPO bei etwa 60,5 %, PPO+Self-reflection bei rund 56,8 % und PPO bei ungefähr 59,1 %. Die höchsten Balken insgesamt finden sich im Physics-Benchmark, wobei DAPO mit etwa 61 % den höchsten Einzelwert aufweist, während die niedrigsten Werte im Mathverse-Benchmark zu beobachten sind, wo DAPO+Self-reflection mit circa 53 % den kürzesten Balken darstellt. Die Unterscheidung zwischen einfarbigen und schraffierten Balken kennzeichnet jeweils die Self-reflection-Variante (einfarbig) gegenüber der Basisvariante (schraffiert) innerhalb derselben Farbgruppe. Die Balken sind nicht nach Wertgröße sortiert, sondern folgen einer konsistenten methodischen Reihenfolge über alle drei Benchmarks hinweg.
